nodes.label: Prisma DIRECT_URL must be unpooled host
nodes.summary: DIRECT_URL in Prisma schema must point to the unpooled Neon host (no -pooler in hostname). pgbouncer transaction-pooling breaks migrate deploy in two distinct ways: invariant violation and stuck advisory lock.

nodes.label: pgbouncer breaks Prisma migration state
nodes.summary: pgbouncer in transaction-pooling mode can hand each statement to a different backend — Prisma reads _prisma_migrations on one backend, applies on another, and the persistence state is gone, causing invariant violation error.

nodes.label: Stuck advisory lock after failed migrate
nodes.summary: A failed migrate deploy via pooler acquires pg_advisory_lock (objid 72707369), then the client disconnects but the pooled backend stays alive holding the lock. Subsequent deploys time out on P1002. Requires pg_terminate_backend via unpooled URL to unstick.

nodes.label: Three orthogonal alerting channels
nodes.summary: UptimeRobot (external uptime), Sentry (in-process errors), and in-API Telegram alerts (business-logic failures) cover orthogonal failure modes. No single channel sees all failures — Sentry can't tell you the server is down; UptimeRobot can't tell you a payment HMAC is failing.

nodes.label: In-API Telegram alert service pattern
nodes.summary: Single sendAlert({level, title, body, context}) function with Redis throttle (5min per sha1(level+title)), plain fetch transport, always-safe try/catch, graceful no-op when env vars missing. P0/P1/info levels. No SDK needed.

nodes.label: Sentry alone is not alerting
nodes.summary: Sentry captures errors but requires the process to be alive to phone home — if the server is unreachable, Sentry sends nothing. Must pair with an external uptime monitor (UptimeRobot) to cover the dead-process failure mode.

nodes.label: Compliance links must be in layout.tsx for SSR
nodes.summary: Ebda Store storefront template footer only renders post-hydration (templateLoading gate). GDPR Art. 7(3) requires cookie preferences link to always be accessible — must add a fallback copy in layout.tsx (server component) to appear in initial HTML for crawlers and JS-disabled visitors.

nodes.label: Dynamic template import blocks SSR HTML
nodes.summary: useTemplateComponents() lazy-loads the template via dynamic import, gating all of header/footer behind templateLoading === true during SSR. The entire footer is absent from initial HTML — any compliance or SEO content in the template footer is invisible to crawlers.

nodes.label: Single eraseAccount() primitive for all erasure triggers
nodes.summary: Ebda Store's AuthService.eraseAccount(userId) is the one transaction-wrapped anonymization method called by self-serve endpoint, retention cron, and future admin override. One place to extend when new PII columns land — all three trigger paths pick it up automatically.

nodes.label: eraseAccount is idempotent by design
nodes.summary: The anonymization upsert is a no-op if email already starts with 'erased-', each deleteMany deletes zero rows on repeat. Safe for cron re-runs or accidental double-calls without double-recording harm beyond an audit log entry.

nodes.label: Orders preserved anonymized for tax compliance
nodes.summary: GDPR erasure does NOT delete Order rows — preserved with customerId = null and scrubbed address JSON. Egypt MOF requires invoice retention ≥5 years. Erasure satisfies Art. 17 while keeping audit trail. Separate 5-year hard-delete cron planned for 2026-12.
